lines.en: - Oh, my God! - Okay, okay.
- Chandler just left, though?
- Yeah, but maybe it's not what we think.
Maybe it's, "Tell Monica I'm sorry.
I drank the last of the milk."
Or maybe he was writing to tell her
that he's changed his name.
You know, "Tell Monica I'm sorry."
- I think it means he freaked out and left.
- Don't be so negative!
Good God, isn't it possible
that "Sorry" is sitting in there right now?
Okay, Phoebe, I think Ross is right.
What are we gonna do?
- Look, okay, I'm just gonna have to go find him
and bring him back, okay?
You make sure Monica does not find out, okay?
- Okay, but if you don't find him and bring him back,
I'm gonna hunt you down and kick your ass.
- I will find him.
- Okay, I'll see you next time.
